what: P-39 on-device clip triage measured in an installed Chrome with the built-in model, on generated clips only
browser: Stephen's Google Chrome 157 stable on this Mac (macOS), after the model download through the site's own 'Get this laptop ready' button; the built-in model reported available for image + text and for text only
page: web/harness/triage.html (dev server http://127.0.0.1:5175), bare Firebase app with no App Check and no sign-in
clips: ALL SYNTHETIC, generated with ffmpeg: no person in any of them

runs.clip: moving-box.mp4: 6 s, a red 40 x 40 square crossing a grey 320 x 240 frame
two-spans.mp4: 20 s, the square visible 4 to 8 s; a second span intended at 14 to 17 s was off-frame (generator error), so one span is correct
still.mp4: 6 s grey frame, nothing moves

findings: Zero requests to Google or Firebase hosts in every run: the frame checks ran on this laptop.
One frame check per span: about 1 s warm (949 and 1,069 ms); the first check after the download took 18.0 s (model load).
Sampling cost: 12 frames in 37 to 45 ms, 40 frames in 158 ms.

The model answered personVisible true for a red square with no person: a false positive. Triage errs toward sending (with consent), so this costs a cloud read, but the on-device person check is NOT validated; that needs the staged clips with and without people.
n: 4 runs, 3 synthetic clips; timings are single observations, not distributions
